name: valuz-dsh-runtime
description: Valuz deploy root for the DeepSeek Harness (dsh) SDK runtime. This manifest IS the plugin closure the deepseek_harness kernel runtime can mount: packaged-bin.js resolves bare Cordis plugins from the node_modules this file materializes, so adding a plugin to the distribution means adding one dependency line here and refreshing the lockfile (scripts/vendor-dsh-runtime.sh). Only the pins are committed; node_modules is fetched at build time (npm ci) and staged into the desktop bundle's libexec, run under Electron-as-node (same pattern as vendor/chrome-devtools-mcp). Unlike the upstream deepseek-harness-runtime-bin closure, this one includes @deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client — without it every session carrying MCP servers fails to boot.
